title: Lava Lamp
description: At the end of combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all card rewards if you took no damage.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks unblocked damage taken during combat. If the player takes no unblocked damage during a combat, all upgradable card rewards at the end of combat are upgraded. Unblockable damage does not count toward triggering the condition.
